# Configuration reference

The configuration file is YAML, JSON or HCL with everything under a
top-level `terraform` key. It is rendered with Jinja before it is
parsed; see [Configuration](../configuration.md) for how the pieces
fit together.

## Top level

Keys allowed under `terraform`.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `definitions` | map of any |  | The terraform root modules to run, in order, keyed by name. |
| `definitions_sources` | map of object |  | Sources whose commands generate definitions. |
| `global_vars` | object |  | Variables merged into every definition. |
| `providers` | map of any |  | Provider requirements and blocks, keyed by provider name. |
| `worker_options` | map of string or boolean |  | Defaults for command line options, keyed by option name with underscores. |
| `handlers` | map of any |  | Handlers to turn on, keyed by handler name. |
| `parallel_options` | object |  | How many definitions are prepared and initialized at once. |
| `locking` | object |  | Wait for held state locks and keep a worker lease; off when unset. |
| `reporting` | object |  | Write run records and definition status beside state; off when unset. |

## Sections

### definitions.&lt;name&gt;

Each entry under `definitions` is one terraform root module run as its own state.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | required | Git URL, or local path looked up under the repository path first. |
| `always_apply` | boolean | `false` | Apply right after this definition is planned, even without --apply or changes. |
| `always_include` | boolean | `false` | Include this definition even when --limit leaves it out. |
| `remote_path_options` | object |  | Options for the remote path of the definition |
| `hooks_disable_remotes` | boolean | `false` | Do not fetch remote state to set TF_REMOTE_* variables for hook scripts. |
| `ignore_global_vars` | boolean | `false` | Merge none of the global_vars into this definition. |
| `ignored_global_terraform_vars` | list of string |  | Global terraform_vars not merged into this definition. |
| `ignored_global_remote_vars` | list of string |  | Global remote_vars not merged into this definition. |
| `ignored_global_template_vars` | list of string |  | Global template_vars not merged into this definition. |
| `use_global_terraform_vars` | list of string |  | When set, only these global terraform_vars are merged into this definition. |
| `use_global_remote_vars` | list of string |  | When set, only these global remote_vars are merged into this definition. |
| `use_global_template_vars` | list of string |  | When set, only these global template_vars are merged into this definition. |
| `terraform_vars` | map of any |  | Variables to pass to terraform via a generated .tfvars file. |
| `remote_vars` | map of string or map or list |  | Variables which are used to generate local references to remote state vars. Supports strings (e.g., 'state.outputs.key'), dicts for mapping keys to remote refs, and lists of remote refs. |
| `squelch_plan_output` | boolean | `false` | Do not stream terraform plan output for this definition. |
| `squelch_apply_output` | boolean | `false` | Do not stream terraform apply output for this definition. |
| `template_vars` | map of string or boolean or list or map |  | Variables which are suppled to any jinja templates. |

### definitions.&lt;name&gt;.remote_path_options

Options for a definition or definitions source whose `path` is a git URL.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branch` | string |  | Branch or tag to clone; master when unset. |
| `sub_path` | string |  | Directory inside the repository that holds the module. |

### definitions_sources.&lt;name&gt;

A source whose command prints more definitions when the configuration loads.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | required | The local path or git URL of the source. |
| `remote_path_options` | object |  | Options for fetching a remote source. |
| `command` | string | required | Command run in the fetched copy; prints definitions as YAML or JSON. |
| `after` | string |  | Insert generated definitions after this definition; appended when unset. |

### global_vars

Variables merged into every definition unless the definition opts out.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `terraform_vars` | map of string or boolean or list or map |  | Variables to pass to terraform via a generated .tfvars file. |
| `remote_vars` | map of string or boolean or list or map |  | Variables which are used to generate local references to remote state vars. |
| `template_vars` | map of string or boolean or list or map |  | Variables which are suppled to any jinja templates. |

### providers.&lt;name&gt;

One entry per terraform provider used by the definitions.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `requirements` | object | required | Version and source for required_providers, written when a definition has none of its own. |
| `vars` | map of any |  | Arguments written into the provider block. |
| `config_blocks` | map of any |  | Nested blocks written into the provider block, such as assume_role. |
| `aliases` | map of object |  | Additional aliased provider blocks, keyed by alias. |

### providers.&lt;name&gt;.requirements

Written to a definition's `required_providers` block when it has none of its own.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | string | required | Version constraint, such as "&gt;= 5.0". |
| `source` | string |  | Provider source address; defaults to hashicorp/&lt;name&gt; on the public registry. |

### providers.&lt;name&gt;.aliases.&lt;alias&gt;

An aliased provider block; its values override the provider's own.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vars` | map of any |  | Arguments merged over the provider's vars for this alias. |
| `config_blocks` | map of any |  | Nested blocks merged over the provider's config_blocks for this alias. |

### parallel_options

How many definitions are prepared and initialized at once.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_preparation_workers` | integer | `8` | Maximum number of parallel workers for file preparation operations |
| `max_init_workers` | integer | `4` | Maximum number of parallel workers for terraform init operations |

### locking

Waits for held state locks; off when the block is absent. Durations are seconds or strings such as `90s` and `1h30m`, and `actions` takes `plan`, `apply` and `destroy`. See [State locks](../locking.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `wait` | number | `600` | How long to wait for a live lock |
| `poll_interval` | number | `15` | The first delay between polls |
| `stale_after` | number | `7200` | A lock older than this, with no lease, is stale |
| `on_stale` | `fail` \| `wait` \| `force_unlock` | `fail` | What to do with a stale lock |
| `heartbeat` | number | `30` | How often the worker lease is refreshed; 0 turns it off |
| `on_timeout` | `fail_definition` \| `fail_run` | `fail_definition` | Fail the definition or the whole run when the wait runs out |
| `actions` | list of `plan` \| `apply` \| `destroy` | `[plan, apply, destroy]` | The terraform actions that wait for the lock |

### reporting

Writes run records and per-definition status beside each state; off when the block is absent. See [Run reporting](../reporting.md).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `resources` | boolean | `true` | Record changed resource addresses, not only counts |
| `state_serials` | boolean | `true` | Read state lineage and serial around plan and apply |
| `tracked_ref` | string |  | The ref provenance compares HEAD with; the remote's default branch when unset |
| `status_retries` | integer | `5` | Attempts at a status update another run raced |

## Handlers

Each key under `handlers` turns on the handler of that name with the
options below. Handlers marked always-on run without a `handlers` entry.

### handlers.bitbucket

The BitbucketHandler class is meant to interact with bitbucket cloud.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | string | required | Bitbucket Cloud username. |
| `password` | string | required | App password for the username. |
| `workspace` | string | required | Workspace that owns the repository. |
| `project` | string | required | Name of the project that holds the repository. |
| `repository` | string | required | Name of the repository. |
| `pull_request` | string | required | The pull request number to add the comment to. |
| `pr_text` | string | built in | Comment posted for each plan with changes; str.format placeholders: {deployment}, {definition} and {text}, the plan output. |

### handlers.datadog

Post a Datadog change event after a successful apply or destroy.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `api_key` | string |  | Datadog API key; read from api_key_env when unset. |
| `app_key` | string |  | Datadog application key; read from app_key_env when unset. |
| `api_key_env` | string | `DD_API_KEY` | Environment variable holding the API key. |
| `app_key_env` | string | `DD_APP_KEY` | Environment variable holding the application key. |

### handlers.github

Report plan and apply progress and results to GitHub.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `repository` | string |  | Repository in 'owner/repo' form; falls back to GITHUB_REPOSITORY. |
| `pull_request` | integer |  | Pull request number to comment on; falls back to GITHUB_PULL_REQUEST or PULL_REQUEST. When unset, only the check run is maintained. |
| `commit_sha` | string |  | Commit sha for the check runs; defaults to the PR head sha, then GITHUB_SHA. Apply-only runs prefer GITHUB_SHA, the planned commit. |
| `app_id` | string |  | GitHub App id; falls back to GITHUB_APP_ID. |
| `private_key` | string |  | GitHub App private key (PEM content); falls back to GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY. |
| `private_key_file` | string |  | Path to the GitHub App private key; falls back to GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE. |
| `installation_id` | integer |  | App installation id; discovered from the repository when unset. Falls back to GITHUB_APP_INSTALLATION_ID. |
| `check_run_name` | string |  | Name of the check run; defaults to 'tfworker/&lt;deployment&gt;/plan'. |
| `apply_check_run_name` | string |  | Name of the apply check run; defaults to 'tfworker/&lt;deployment&gt;/apply'. |
| `details_url` | string |  | Template for the rollup check runs' details link; falls back to GITHUB_CHECK_DETAILS_URL. str.format placeholders: {run_id}, {deployment}, {definition} (empty), {from_ts} and {to_ts} (epoch ms). |
| `definition_details_url` | string |  | Template for the per-definition check runs' details link, with the placeholders of details_url; falls back to GITHUB_CHECK_DEFINITION_DETAILS_URL, then details_url. |
| `logs_url` | string |  | Template for a labelled logs link in the rollup check runs' output, with the placeholders of details_url; falls back to GITHUB_CHECK_LOGS_URL. |
| `definition_logs_url` | string |  | Template for the logs link in the per-definition check runs' output; falls back to GITHUB_CHECK_DEFINITION_LOGS_URL, then logs_url. |
| `logs_label` | string |  | Text of the logs link; falls back to GITHUB_CHECK_LOGS_LABEL, then 'View logs'. |
| `comment_marker` | string | `tfworker-status` | Hidden marker that identifies the worker's PR comment so later runs update it in place. |
| `comment_details` | boolean | `false` | Include per-definition detail (plan output or AI summary) in the PR comment, split across additional comments when needed. When false the comment carries only the status table; detail lives in the check run output. |
| `max_detail_chars` | integer | `8000` | Maximum characters of per-definition detail included in check run output, which cannot be split. PR comments always carry the full detail, split across comments as needed. |
| `wrap_width` | integer | `120` | Hard-wrap fenced plan and error output at this column so check run pages do not scroll horizontally. 0 disables wrapping. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` |  |

### handlers.local_plans

Always on.

Write and check manifests for plans saved with --plan-file-path.

No options.

### handlers.openai

Analyze terraform plans using OpenAI.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tasks` | map of object | built in | Tasks to run on each plan with changes, keyed by summary, cost_payload or cost_estimate; a summary task when unset. |
| `send_plan_file` | boolean | `false` | Send the plan JSON instead of the plan's text output. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | Stop the run when the handler cannot start or a request fails. |

#### handlers.openai.tasks.&lt;task&gt;

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model` | `gpt-3.5-turbo` \| `gpt-4` \| `gpt-4o` \| `gpt-4o-mini` \| `gpt-4.1` \| `gpt-4.1-nano` | `gpt-4.1-nano` | OpenAI model to use. |
| `level` | `concise` \| `standard` \| `verbose` | `standard` | How much detail the summary prompt asks for; summary task only. |
| `custom_prompt` | string |  | Prompt sent ahead of the plan instead of the task's built-in prompt. |

### handlers.s3

Always on.

Save plans in the state bucket so a later run can apply them.

No options.

### handlers.slack

Post a live-updating Slack report for each terraform-worker run.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `channel` | string | required | Channel to post the run report in. |
| `token` | string |  | Bot token; read from token_env when unset. |
| `token_env` | string | `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` | Environment variable holding the bot token. |
| `title` | string |  | Title of the report card; the deployment name when unset. |
| `links` | list of object |  | Links shown in the report card, each with text and url. |
| `definition_log_url_template` | string |  | Link to a definition's logs on its failure card; {definition} is replaced with the definition name. |
| `update_interval` | number | `4` | Minimum seconds between updates of the Slack messages. |
| `timezone` | string | `America/Chicago` | Time zone of the fallback timestamp text; live timestamps show in each viewer's own time zone. |

#### handlers.slack.links[]

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | string | required | Link text. |
| `url` | string | required | Link target. |

### handlers.snyk

The SnykHandler will execute a snyk scan on a specified terraform plan file

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `debug` | boolean | `false` | Log the snyk command line at debug level. |
| `path` | string | `/usr/bin/snyk` | Path to the snyk binary. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | Stop the run when snyk is missing or a scan fails; a failed scan also removes the saved plan. |
| `skip_planfile` | boolean | `false` | Skip the scan of the plan after planning. |
| `skip_definition` | boolean | `true` | Skip both scans of every definition, the source before planning and the plan after it. |
| `stream_output` | boolean | `true` | Stream snyk's output. |
| `exempt_definitions` | list of string |  | Definitions that are never scanned. |

### handlers.sqs

Send execution details to AWS SQS.

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `queues` | list of string or map of object |  | Queue URLs, or a map of queue URL to rules for that queue. |
| `actions` | list of `plan` \| `apply` \| `destroy` \| `init` |  | Legacy format: actions to send; all when unset. |
| `stages` | list of `pre` \| `post` \| `error` |  | Legacy format: stages to send; pre and post when unset. |
| `results` | list of integer |  | Legacy format: terraform exit codes to send; when set, messages without a result, such as pre stages, are not sent. |
| `include_plan` | boolean | `false` | Include plan file content when sending post plan messages |
| `format` | `legacy` \| `cloudevents` | `legacy` | legacy sends one message per terraform stage; cloudevents publishes the report events |
| `types` | list of string |  | CloudEvents types to publish (shell-style patterns); all when unset |
| `event_bus` | string |  | An EventBridge bus to publish CloudEvents to |
| `event_source` | string | `tfworker` | The EventBridge Source of published events |

#### handlers.sqs.queues.&lt;url&gt;

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | list of `plan` \| `apply` \| `destroy` \| `init` |  | Actions sent to this queue; the handler's actions when unset. |
| `stages` | list of `pre` \| `post` \| `error` |  | Stages sent to this queue; the handler's stages when unset. |
| `results` | list of integer |  | Terraform exit codes sent to this queue; the handler's results when unset. |
| `types` | list of string |  | CloudEvents types sent to this queue (shell-style patterns); the handler's types when unset. |

### handlers.trivy

The TrivyHandler will execute a trivy scan on a specified terraform plan file

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `args` | map |  | Extra trivy options, each key passed as --&lt;key&gt; &lt;value&gt;. |
| `cache_dir` | string | `/tmp/trivy_cache` | Passed as --cache-dir. |
| `debug` | boolean | `false` | Pass --debug and log the trivy command line at debug level. |
| `exit_code` | string | `1` | Passed as --exit-code, the code trivy exits with when it finds issues; any non-zero exit fails the scan. |
| `format` | string |  | Passed as --format; with template, template is passed as --template. |
| `path` | string | `/usr/bin/trivy` | Path to the trivy binary. |
| `quiet` | boolean | `true` | Pass --quiet. |
| `required` | boolean | `false` | Stop the run when trivy is missing or a scan fails; a failed plan scan also removes the saved plan. |
| `severity` | string | `HIGH,CRITICAL` | Passed as --severity. |
| `skip_dirs` | list | `[**/examples]` | Passed as --skip-dirs when scanning a definition's source. |
| `template` | string | built in | Template passed as --template when format is template. |
| `skip_planfile` | boolean | `false` | Skip the scan of the plan after planning. |
| `skip_definition` | boolean | `false` | Skip the scan of the definition's source before planning. |
| `stream_output` | boolean | `true` | Stream trivy's output. |
